meta.description: Step-oriented proposal, reason, affected-file, and disposition registry for Workspace_AI governance checkpoints.
changelog: 2.18.0 - Added read-only target-local proposal cleanup scanner

2.13.0 - Added repository lifecycle boundary cases and event-triggered integrity preflight policy

2.10.0 - Added realistic phased documentation-first dry-run sequence

2.6.0 - Added read-only Git metadata observation policy for real-repository dry-run

2.3.0 - Added guarded real-repository dry-run contract and preparation commands

2.1.0 - Added real-repository test plan placeholder, policy validation, stale-reference scan, and readiness integration

proposals.proposal: Replace Copilot task hook with native PowerShell governance entrypoints.
proposals.reason: Gemini/Continue migration requires native scripts instead of copilot:* task commands.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted as an intermediate checkpoint before the first Workspace_AI governance commit.

proposals.proposal: Add Continue/Gemini rule discovery for Workspace_AI.
proposals.reason: Continue/Gemini must discover Workspace_AI rule authority without modifying Workspace_AC.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted as an intermediate checkpoint before the first Workspace_AI governance commit.

proposals.proposal: Align workspace settings JSON with repository meta-header convention.
proposals.reason: Repo JSON files use a top-level meta block instead of comments as durable header metadata.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted as an intermediate checkpoint before the first Workspace_AI governance commit.

proposals.proposal: Replace APPLY.ps1 stub with native fix descriptor validation.
proposals.reason: Fix executions must run natively through PowerShell 7 for Gemini/Continue migration.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted as an intermediate checkpoint before the first Workspace_AI governance commit.

proposals.proposal: Separate checkpoint and permanent governance log semantics.
proposals.reason: Step-oriented logs may be overwritten at checkpoints; permanent logs should reflect accepted committed changes only.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted as an intermediate checkpoint before the first Workspace_AI governance commit.

proposals.proposal: Add explicit rule-authority and Continue bridge policy.
proposals.reason: Continue/Gemini must inherit the same rules as .copilot without creating an independent rule fork.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted as an intermediate checkpoint before the first Workspace_AI governance commit.

proposals.proposal: Move step proposal records out of Generate-Log.ps1 into a structured JSON registry.
proposals.reason: Step-oriented logs must record proposals, reasons, affected files, and final disposition without hardcoding the governance history in script logic.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted for the first Workspace_AI governance commit.

proposals.proposal: Classify generated governance logs as implicit artifacts instead of reviewable proposal files.
proposals.reason: Generated logs do their thing and are implicitly accepted; proposal disposition applies to the rule or method change, not to generated log output.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after clarifying that generated logs are implicit artifacts, not reviewable proposal targets.

proposals.proposal: Formalize proposal dispositions as pending-review, accepted, rejected, or modified.
proposals.reason: Step-oriented logs must record rejected and modified proposals consistently, while permanent logs only represent accepted committed results.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after manual review of normalized disposition semantics.

proposals.proposal: Add native proposal registry management command.
proposals.reason: Proposal dispositions should be updated through a deterministic PowerShell interface instead of manual JSON editing.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness self-test validated stabilization state creation.

proposals.proposal: Add proposal disposition validation fixture with accepted, rejected, and modified coverage.
proposals.reason: Governance validation should prove that rejected and modified dispositions are accepted when required details are present.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness self-test validated read-only sibling repository discovery.

proposals.proposal: Add explicit generated-artifact section to the step governance log.
proposals.reason: The step log should show which logs were regenerated without treating those log files as accepted, rejected, or modified proposals.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after clarifying that generated logs are implicit artifacts, not proposal decisions.

proposals.proposal: Group generated log changes separately from reviewable pending changes.
proposals.reason: Generated log files are implicit artifacts and should not appear as if they require accepted, rejected, or modified dispositions.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after validating reviewable and generated artifact status grouping.

proposals.proposal: Add proposal disposition summary reporting.
proposals.reason: Governance output should show pending-review, accepted, rejected, and modified proposal counts without manually scanning the full step log.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness self-test validated sibling repository ignore coverage.

proposals.proposal: Ignore sibling Git repositories in Workspace_AI VS Code settings during stabilization.
proposals.reason: Until Workspace_AI is ready to be tested against real repositories, VS Code Git discovery should focus on Workspace_AI and ignore other D:\Git_Repositories repositories.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after validating temporary VS Code Git ignore list for sibling repositories.

proposals.proposal: Add Workspace_AI stabilization state file.
proposals.reason: The migration needs an explicit machine-readable state that says Workspace_AI is still self-stabilizing and not yet testing against real repositories.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after Workspace_AI readiness self-test completed successfully.

proposals.proposal: Add read-only sibling repository discovery command.
proposals.reason: Workspace_AI should be able to discover sibling repositories without modifying or inspecting their contents before real-repo testing is enabled.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness self-test validated read-only sibling repository discovery.

proposals.proposal: Add validation that VS Code ignores sibling repositories during Workspace_AI stabilization.
proposals.reason: The temporary git.ignoredRepositories setting should be validated against the current sibling repository list until Workspace_AI is ready for real-repo testing.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness self-test validated sibling repository ignore coverage.

proposals.proposal: Add native Workspace_AI readiness self-test wrapper.
proposals.reason: Before testing against a real repository, Workspace_AI needs a single self-test command that runs JSON, PowerShell, APPLY, log generation, governance, and ignore-list validation checks.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after Workspace_AI readiness self-test completed successfully.

proposals.proposal: Report Workspace_AI stabilization state from native governance validation.
proposals.reason: Advance-Governance should print the current stabilization phase and whether real-repository testing is enabled.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after governance output reported stabilization state and real-repository testing status.

proposals.proposal: Add real-repository test plan placeholder.
proposals.reason: Workspace_AI needs an explicit not-yet-enabled test plan before selecting or touching a real repository.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness self-test confirmed no real repository is selected or enabled.

proposals.proposal: Add off-limits and real-repository policy validation.
proposals.reason: Governance should validate that Workspace_AC and backup base paths remain protected while real-repository writes are disabled.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after stabilization policy validation passed during readiness self-test.

proposals.proposal: Add active-surface stale Workspace_AC reference scan.
proposals.reason: Before real-repository testing, active Workspace_AI methods and adapter settings should not retain accidental Workspace_AC authority references except explicit no-touch policy references.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after stale authority reference scan reported zero unexpected references.

proposals.proposal: Integrate stabilization policy and stale-reference checks into readiness self-test.
proposals.reason: The single readiness command should include off-limits policy validation and stale-reference scanning before any real repository is selected.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after the integrated readiness self-test completed successfully.

proposals.proposal: Report real-repository test plan and policy checks from native governance validation.
proposals.reason: Advance-Governance should show that no real repository is selected, real-repository testing is disabled, and policy checks pass.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after native governance reported real-repository selection and stabilization policy status.

proposals.proposal: Consolidate helper verification scripts into a quality-gate module.
proposals.reason: Workspace_AI should expose fewer standalone verification scripts while preserving reusable readiness checks.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation confirmed the quality-gate module replaced helper test scripts.

proposals.proposal: Keep Test-WorkspaceReadiness.ps1 as the single public verification command.
proposals.reason: Operators should have one readiness command; narrower gates should be implementation details unless a focused failure needs diagnosis.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation confirmed the single public verification command.

proposals.proposal: Update readiness parsing to validate the quality-gate module instead of removed helper scripts.
proposals.reason: The readiness command should continue validating active governance code after helper checks move into a module.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation parsed the quality-gate module successfully.

proposals.proposal: Update native governance validation to consume the quality-gate module.
proposals.reason: Advance-Governance should use the same consolidated quality-gate implementation as the readiness command.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized native governance validation consumed the quality-gate module successfully.

proposals.proposal: Document the lighter verification cadence for Workspace_AI stabilization.
proposals.reason: The normal workflow should run the single readiness command and only use narrower checks when that command reports a targeted failure.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation confirmed the lighter verification cadence.

proposals.proposal: Expand the real-repository test plan into a dry-run contract.
proposals.reason: Workspace_AI needs explicit machine-readable rules for blocked, selected, and read-only dry-run states before any real repository is touched.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness validation confirmed blocked dry-run contract state.

proposals.proposal: Add a quality gate for real-repository test plan policy.
proposals.reason: The consolidated quality-gate module should reject write-enabled plans, self-targeting, and off-limits candidate repositories.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after real-repository test plan policy validation passed.

proposals.proposal: Add a guarded real-repository test plan update command.
proposals.reason: Future candidate selection should be deterministic and should not imply write enablement.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after guarded test plan update command parsed and readiness validation passed.

proposals.proposal: Add a read-only real-repository dry-run reporter.
proposals.reason: Workspace_AI should be able to report blocked or ready dry-run status without mutating a target repository.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after dry-run reporter returned blocked state without external repository access.

proposals.proposal: Integrate real-repository test plan validation into the readiness command.
proposals.reason: The one public readiness command should verify dry-run policy without adding extra operator-facing verification steps.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness command validated real-repository test plan policy.

proposals.proposal: Integrate dry-run status reporting into the readiness command.
proposals.reason: Readiness output should show that dry-run is currently blocked because no repository is selected.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness output reported blocked dry-run state.

proposals.proposal: Report real-repository dry-run status from native governance validation.
proposals.reason: Advance-Governance should surface the dry-run block or ready state together with stabilization status.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after native governance reported dry-run status with stabilization state.

proposals.proposal: Document real-repository dry-run guardrails in the quality-gate workflow.
proposals.reason: Operators need a short statement that selecting a candidate and dry-run preparation remain read-only.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after quality-gate workflow documented the dry-run guardrails for current operators.

proposals.proposal: Preserve the reduced verification cadence while adding dry-run checks.
proposals.reason: Additional safety checks should not reintroduce multiple manual verification commands.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness validation preserved the single-command verification cadence.

proposals.proposal: Keep real-repository dry-run blocked until explicit candidate selection.
proposals.reason: Workspace_AI must remain self-stabilizing and must not inspect or mutate external repositories before explicit user selection.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness validation confirmed dry-run remains blocked until explicit candidate selection.

proposals.proposal: Add transition policy fields to the real-repository test plan.
proposals.reason: Dry-run state changes need explicit machine-readable rules for candidate selection, read-only confirmation, and reset behavior.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness validation confirmed transition policy fields and blocked state.

proposals.proposal: Add dry-run observation report fields to the real-repository test plan.
proposals.reason: The plan should record that current dry-run reporting is not-run until an explicit candidate and dry-run mode exist.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness validation reported dry-run observation fields without external access.

proposals.proposal: Validate real-repository transition policy from the quality-gate module.
proposals.reason: Readiness checks should reject write-capable transition policy, inconsistent modes, and dry-run without a selected repository.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after quality-gate validation enforced transition policy consistency.

proposals.proposal: Require selected dry-run candidates to be existing Git repositories.
proposals.reason: Candidate selection should fail early if the path is not a real Git repository, while still refusing off-limits paths.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after guarded candidate validation parsed and readiness passed.

proposals.proposal: Require explicit read-only confirmation before enabling dry-run mode.
proposals.reason: Dry-run activation should be a deliberate operator action and must not imply write access.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after dry-run activation required explicit read-only confirmation.

proposals.proposal: Add read-only real-repository test plan inspection command.
proposals.reason: Operators and governance checks need a simple way to inspect plan state without changing it or touching external repositories.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after read-only test plan inspection reported current blocked state.

proposals.proposal: Report planned observation and forbidden-action counts from dry-run reporter.
proposals.reason: Dry-run output should summarize its allowed read-only scope without requiring full documentation yet.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after dry-run reporter summarized planned observations and forbidden actions.

proposals.proposal: Integrate plan inspection into the single readiness command.
proposals.reason: The readiness command should display the current real-repository plan state without adding a second verification command.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after readiness command integrated plan inspection successfully.

proposals.proposal: Report read-only confirmation requirement from native governance validation.
proposals.reason: Governance output should make clear that dry-run activation still requires explicit read-only confirmation.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after governance output reported read-only confirmation requirement.

proposals.proposal: Keep real-repository flow documentation deferred while exposing machine-readable behavior.
proposals.reason: The repository is not ready for full real-repo use-case documentation, but the later documentation should be grounded in validated commands and policy fields.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after behavior remained machine-readable while broader flow documentation stayed deferred.

proposals.proposal: Add adapter surface candidates to the real-repository dry-run plan.
proposals.reason: Dry-run reporting should know which Workspace_AI adapter surfaces to inventory in a selected target repository without writing them.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation reported four adapter surface candidates.

proposals.proposal: Add target profile state to the real-repository test plan.
proposals.reason: The plan needs a durable read-only profile shape before a real target repository is selected.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation reported blocked target profile state.

proposals.proposal: Validate target profile and adapter surface inventory fields from the quality-gate module.
proposals.reason: Readiness should reject missing adapter inventory and any target-profile write probe state.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation checked adapter inventory and no-write profile state.

proposals.proposal: Add read-only real-repository target profile command.
proposals.reason: The dry-run flow needs a command that profiles a selected target by reading path identity, git status, and adapter surface presence only.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation parsed and executed blocked target profile reporting.

proposals.proposal: Keep target profile blocked until real-repository dry-run is explicitly enabled.
proposals.reason: Workspace_AI should not inspect target repository details before candidate selection and read-only dry-run confirmation.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation confirmed target profile remains blocked until dry-run enablement.

proposals.proposal: Add target profile summary to the real-repository dry-run reporter.
proposals.reason: Dry-run output should include whether target profiling is blocked or complete plus adapter surface counts.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation reported target profile status and adapter counts from dry-run output.

proposals.proposal: Expose target profile summary in the read-only test plan inspection command.
proposals.reason: Operators should be able to see profile readiness and adapter candidate count without invoking a write-capable flow.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation exposed target profile summary through plan inspection.

proposals.proposal: Integrate target profile reporting into the single readiness command.
proposals.reason: The one-command readiness cadence should show that target profiling remains blocked until a repository is explicitly selected.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation integrated target profile reporting in the single command.

proposals.proposal: Report adapter surface candidate count from native governance validation.
proposals.reason: Governance output should summarize how many target adapter surfaces the dry-run profile will inventory later.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized governance output reported adapter surface candidate count.

proposals.proposal: Keep real-repository dry-run profiling read-only and non-probing.
proposals.reason: Target profiling should explicitly report that no write probe is performed, preserving the dry-run safety model.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation confirmed WriteProbePerformed remains false.

proposals.proposal: Add an explicit read-only Git command allow-list to the real-repository dry-run plan.
proposals.reason: Dry-run metadata collection should be bounded to known read-only Git commands before any real repository is selected.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation reported four allowed read-only Git commands.

proposals.proposal: Add repository root identity as a planned dry-run observation.
proposals.reason: A real-repository dry-run should confirm the selected path resolves to the expected Git root without writing to it.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation kept repository root metadata blocked until target selection.

proposals.proposal: Add current branch name as a planned dry-run observation.
proposals.reason: Dry-run reporting should show the target repository branch context using read-only Git metadata.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation kept branch metadata blocked until target selection.

proposals.proposal: Add current HEAD commit id as a planned dry-run observation.
proposals.reason: Dry-run reporting should identify the exact target commit context without modifying the target repository.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation kept HEAD metadata blocked until target selection.

proposals.proposal: Validate that the real-repository Git command allow-list excludes write-capable commands.
proposals.reason: The quality gate should reject accidental git add, commit, checkout, reset, clean, merge, rebase, or stash commands in dry-run policy.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation enforced the read-only Git command allow-list.

proposals.proposal: Expose allowed Git command count from read-only test plan inspection.
proposals.reason: Operators should see the dry-run command boundary without reading the full plan JSON.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation exposed allowed Git command count from plan inspection.

proposals.proposal: Report allowed Git command count from native governance validation.
proposals.reason: Governance output should summarize the allowed read-only Git command boundary for dry-run mode.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized governance output reported allowed Git command count.

proposals.proposal: Add root, branch, and HEAD metadata to the read-only target profile command.
proposals.reason: Once dry-run is explicitly enabled, the target profile should report useful Git context while staying read-only.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation reported target profile metadata fields without external inspection.

proposals.proposal: Surface read-only Git metadata in the real-repository dry-run report.
proposals.reason: The dry-run reporter should include target root verification, branch, and HEAD fields from the target profile.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized dry-run output surfaced root, branch, and HEAD fields in blocked state.

proposals.proposal: Keep read-only Git metadata blocked while no real repository is selected.
proposals.reason: The additional metadata fields must not cause any external repository inspection before explicit candidate selection and read-only dry-run enablement.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted after synchronized readiness validation confirmed metadata remains blocked while no repository is selected.

proposals.proposal: Add first inspectable real-repository dry-run case document.
proposals.reason: The implemented dry-run behavior is now concrete enough to review as cases and flows without designing write-capable adaptation yet.
proposals.disposition_reason: Accepted for the day-end Workspace_AI methodology checkpoint.
proposals.final_result: Accepted for commit in the day-end Workspace_AI methodology checkpoint.
